meta.description: Registry for branch-related failure modes in Phase 2 of the Mono-Process Formal Law Program.

failure_modes.name: branch_explosion
failure_modes.description: Unconstrained candidate generation leads to a non-summable or computationally unfeasible number of concurrent process states.

failure_modes.name: unstable_pruning
failure_modes.description: Pruning decisions switch erratically between disparate branch sets under small perturbations.

failure_modes.name: loss_of_admissible_path
failure_modes.description: Pruning logic inadvertently removes all valid continuation paths, leading to premature process termination.

failure_modes.name: pruning_bias
failure_modes.description: Selection criteria systematically favor certain regimes, leading to orientation drift or residue accumulation.

failure_modes.name: equivalence_collapse_error
failure_modes.description: Merging non-equivalent branches results in information loss or formal consistency violations.

failure_modes.name: orientation_pruning_conflict
failure_modes.description: Pruning based on orientation minimization contradicts admissibility or residue requirements.

failure_modes.name: residue_pruning_divergence
failure_modes.description: Residue-weighted pruning results in positive feedback loops and state divergence.

failure_modes.name: recursive_branch_drift
failure_modes.description: Iteration results in branch sets drifting outside the declared stabilized recurrence basins.

failure_modes.name: branch_bound_violation
failure_modes.description: The number of retained branches exceeds the declared finite or conditional bound.
